defects.justification: The app imports flask (and tests import pytest) but there is no dependency manifest at all; the README only says `pip install flask pytest` with no versions.
Customer name and email from the database are written to the CSV export unescaped, so a customer named e.g. `=HYPERLINK(...)` becomes a live formula when an admin opens the export in a spreadsheet.
The export has no limit or pagination: fetchall() loads every matching order into memory and then builds the whole JSON/CSV body in memory, so an unfiltered export of a large shop can exhaust memory.
parse_int has no bounds for customer_id, so a value beyond 64 bits makes sqlite3 raise OverflowError when binding, giving a 500 instead of a 400.
end=9999-12-31 parses fine but `end + timedelta(days=1)` raises OverflowError, which is not caught and returns a 500.
